name: Thaana
summary: Shadcn registry of Dhivehi-first components and blocks with Thaana script and RTL defaults.
description: A shadcn registry (name: thaana) of Dhivehi-first UI: shadcn components rebuilt with overridable Thaana and RTL defaults, including input, select, mixed-direction search and combobox, a Gregorian and Umm al-Qura Hijri date picker, Maldives island and map pickers, form field, dropdown menu, pagination, dialog content, MVR currency and +960 phone inputs and a data table. It also ships two blocks: customer management and an invoice form.
contains: 16 shadcn registry items: 14 components and 2 blocks
Dhivehi, Thaana and RTL defaults throughout
Umm al-Qura Hijri and Gregorian calendar support
Maldives data: atoll-grouped islands, +960 phone numbers, MVR currency
blocks: customer management and invoice form
